question: Will Canada's GDP growth rate MoM in July 2026 be less than 0.0%?
rationale: Mechanical-econ carve-out bet (gates 1-4 checked). BENCHMARK QUOTED: StatCan July 2026 advance estimate 'essentially unchanged' (The Daily, Aug 28 2026); Scotiabank Economics reads that as -0.1 to +0.1; TradingEconomics 'expected to have remained unchanged from the previous month per a flash estimate'. DISPERSION SOURCED (gate-2 variance clause): n=14 flash/first-print pairs fetched from The Daily May25-Jun26, errors 0 x3 / +0.1 x6 / -0.1 x2 / +0.2 x1 / -0.2 x1 / -0.3 x1, mean +0.02 sd 0.13 -> raw P(print<0.0)=4/14=0.286, tilted to 0.26 for the positive error momentum. Ask 0.12 -> edge 0.14, inside the 0.10-0.20 carve-out band, >0.20 not claimed. Spread 0.03 (bid 0.09/ask 0.12) under max_spread 0.06. One bet on this print event: the 0.0-0.1 No leg carries only ~0.10 edge, this leg is the better expression. WHY THE MARKET IS WRONG: on 09-18 this same leg was bid 0.26/ask 0.31 and I recorded market-agrees; it has since repriced to 0.09/0.12 on ~1 USD of 24h volume and ~1000 liquidity, while the sourced flash-error series did not move. Thin-book reprice, not information - the one genuinely new July datum since the flash (retail sales -0.7 m/m, StatCan Sep 24) cuts mildly NEGATIVE for GDP yet the negative bracket got cheaper. Forecast acf23d7aae1d.

question: Will JOLTS Job Openings be between 7.4M and 7.5M in August?
rationale: JOLTS Aug openings 7.4-7.5M bracket, No side. Benchmark QUOTED at research time: investing.com consensus 7.230M for the Sep 29 release, LinkUp advance estimate 7.18M (pub Sep 10), BLS July actual 7.271M. Dispersion SOURCED from the same calendar's 10-month actual-vs-forecast table: misses Nov25..Jul26 mean -0.045 sd 0.413 raw / 0.244 ex-outliers, own sd 0.30. N(7.21,0.30) gives P(7.4-7.5)=0.0965 so P(No)=0.9035 vs No ask 0.82, edge 0.0835, spread 0.02, ask size 316 shares. The market is wrong on the MEAN, not the variance: normalising the ladder's 8 Yes mids (sum 1.0665) implies a market mean of ~7.29M, i.e. roughly unchanged from July, while consensus, LinkUp and the Apr-Jul trend (-116k/mo) all sit at 7.18-7.23M. Edge holds across sd 0.20-0.41 (0.079-0.098) since this bracket is in the right tail on any of them. Corroborating shape: the 7.2-7.3M bucket containing both consensus and July's print is priced below its neighbours (0.112 vs 0.1345 and 0.174), a non-monotonic dip at the central tendency, and the 6.65pct ladder overround makes every Yes mid rich / No cheap - the side score.py's threshold_sweep_no shows profitable (edge>=0.07 n=109 ROI +0.108) against threshold_sweep negative in every bucket. Settles on the precise thousands figure per the resolution text, boundary to the higher bracket. Claimed edge under 0.10, so no outside-view-veto and no carve-out invoked; supersedes nothing (the 13:52Z row declined this leg for want of a consensus benchmark, which is exactly what was found this cycle).
